nextcloud.title: Family Cloud
nextcloud.intro: Connects your planner to Nextcloud without giving up control of family accounts or child rules.
nextcloud.dockerModeHint: Recommended for the new all-in-one installation
nextcloud.existingModeHint: On your home network or via your own domain
nextcloud.securityDockerTitle: A cloud account just for your family
nextcloud.securityDockerBody: LX Family creates the account, calendar and app password automatically. Other families get separate cloud areas.
nextcloud.securityExistingBody: Your regular Nextcloud password is not needed. The app password is stored encrypted on your LX Family server.
nextcloud.baseUrlHint: Address reachable from the LX Family server.
nextcloud.publicUrlHintBundled: Provided by the LX server – no made-up port on the planner domain.
nextcloud.publicUrlHintDocker: On your home network usually http://SERVER-IP:8080; publicly, a dedicated cloud domain without a port.
nextcloud.publicUrlHintExisting: This address will later open your family folder.
nextcloud.attentionTitle: Family Cloud needs a moment of attention
nextcloud.calendarCapabilityBody: Changes flow safely in both directions.
nextcloud.backupCapabilityBody: Every family gets its own data archive.
nextcloud.grandparentsBody: Only enable this if these events should deliberately appear in the shared Nextcloud calendar.
nextcloud.accessNote: These details are only loaded when you explicitly click and are not stored in the browser.
nextcloud.copiedBody: You can now paste the value into Nextcloud.
nextcloud.copyFailedBody: Please select the value directly in the field.

uploadDestination.title: Where should the upload go?
uploadDestination.noFolders: There is no folder in this area yet.

databaseBackup.title: Database backups
databaseBackup.intro: Creates a complete, verified backup of this LX installation. Only the first or configured owner family can see this section.
databaseBackup.scheduleHint: A missed run is performed once when the server is available again.
databaseBackup.created: A verified database backup was created.
databaseBackup.restoreGuide: Never replace SQLite files in the data directory manually. Choose a verified backup below: LX creates a safety copy first, handles the database files and restarts in a controlled way.
databaseBackup.restoreWarning: All changes after this backup will be lost. LX first creates an additional safety backup and then restarts.
databaseBackup.restoreRestarting: The database is being restored. LX will restart afterwards.

recycleBin.title: Recycle bin
recycleBin.intro: Deleted events, tasks and other entries stay here for {{days}} days and can be restored one at a time.
recycleBin.emptyBody: Deleted entries can be safely brought back here for a while.
recycleBin.removeConfirm: Delete this entry permanently from the recycle bin? This cannot be undone.

familyTransfer.title: Move family to another server
familyTransfer.intro: Creates a protected move file for this family only. It can be restored on a new, still empty LX server.
familyTransfer.noteBody: Events, tasks, notes, recipes, profiles and the recycle bin move with you. Reconnect Family Cloud, CalDAV, Home Assistant, Bring and notification devices on the new server afterwards.
familyTransfer.passphraseTooShort: The move passphrase must be at least 12 characters long.
familyTransfer.passphraseMismatch: The two move passphrases do not match.
familyTransfer.exported: The encrypted move file was downloaded. Keep the file and passphrase separate and safe.
familyTransfer.footnote: The file can only be read with the move passphrase. Without it, it cannot be restored.
